metadataRaw.title: How to INSTANTLY Relieve Neck Arthritis Pain
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows safe, easy exercises to help neck pain caused from arthritis.

These exercises are designed to help relieve aches, stiffness, and muscle tightness caused from spinal osteoarthritis (wear and tear arthritis). They're also good for spinal stenosis and degenerative disc disease. 

All of the exercises work just a little bit differently. To get the best results, go through all of them and use what gives the most relief. 

As a bonus, all of the exercises can be done at home, require no equipment, and may give instant neck pain relief. 

Chapters: 
0:00 Intro
0:38 Tight Muscle Release
3:20 Joint Stiffness Release
6:19 Posture Exercise
8:02 Daily Stretch
